openQuestions.text: What is the exact project identifier value or canonical project context identifier for specstest across all APIs and records?
What is the exact API endpoint for creating, updating, and retrieving individual BRD requirement records?
What is the exact API endpoint for retrieving BRD requirement history?
What are the exact request/response schemas for architecture baseline, packaging, deployment, BRD baseline, BRD requirement, prerequisite, readiness, and audit APIs?
What are the exact allowed `approvalStatus` values for packaging and deployment records?
What are the exact mandatory metadata fields described as “any required project-linked metadata” for packaging?
What are the exact fields that define “architecture scope” for build-finalization gate evaluation?
What are the exact fields required to document “support-relevant deployment considerations for installation, update, and recovery scenarios”?

What are the exact BRD lifecycle states and transition rules beyond the examples `draft`, `under review`, `approved`, and `superseded`? Is `rejected` a formal BRD document status or only a review/approval outcome?
What are the exact architecture baseline approval workflow roles and assignment rules, since some stories refer to reviewers generically?
What are the exact permissions for read access to BRD, architecture, deployment, prerequisite, and audit data by each actor?
What are the exact payload requirements for change request approval details and integration proposal metadata?
What is the required retention period for audit logs and immutable history beyond the stated ability to retrieve 12 months of BRD history?
What is the exact definition of “complete” for BRD baseline and architecture baseline outside the explicitly listed required fields?
What is the exact endpoint or transaction contract for build finalization and final build approval?
What is the exact representation of runtime dependency entries: name only, name/version pairs, or structured objects in all cases?
What are the exact normalization rules for BRD version values?
What is the exact notification payload and delivery mechanism for document owner notifications after BRD review actions?
Are view actions on controlled records required to be audit logged universally, or only included in audit reports where captured by the repository/security controls?
What are the specific enterprise-approved encryption standards referenced for data in transit and at rest?

userStories.title: Windows Application Foundation
As a Desktop Engineer, I want to document the Windows packaging approach so that the specstest application can be built and distributed consistently
As a Deployment Manager, I want to define the Windows deployment method so that the specstest application can be released through an approved enterprise path
As a Business Analyst, I want to maintain the BRD as the authoritative requirement baseline so that the Windows application scope remains clear and reviewable
As a Project Manager, I want to control scope additions and integration changes so that the Windows application is delivered without unapproved requirements
As a Business Analyst, I want to link each BRD requirement to its source requirement identifier so that scope decisions remain traceable
As an Audit Manager, I want to view change history for BRD requirement records so that document lineage remains verifiable
As a Security Administrator, I want to enforce role-based access and audit logging for the Windows application baseline so that controlled project records remain protected and reviewable
As a Requirements Manager, I want to manage BRD version and status transitions so that document control remains compliant and traceable
As a Stakeholder Reviewer, I want to review requirement entries in a formal approval workflow so that the BRD can progress through controlled governance gates
As an Approval Manager, I want to finalize BRD approval outcomes so that only reviewed requirements become the active project baseline
As a Project Manager, I want build readiness to depend on BRD and architecture approval status so that build finalization does not bypass governance gates
As a Release Manager, I want to enforce the architecture readiness gate before build finalization so that incomplete baseline decisions do not block deployment preparation
As a Security Architect, I want the BRD and architecture baseline repository to enforce secure access and audit reporting so that governance evidence is available for enterprise review
As a Governance Lead, I want build finalization blocked until the architecture baseline is approved so that the Windows application follows formal stage-gate controls
As a Solution Reviewer, I want unapproved integration assumptions flagged during baseline review so that the Windows application scope stays aligned to approved source requirements
As an Enterprise Architect, I want to block unsupported external integration assumptions so that the specstest Windows application remains within approved scope
As a Stakeholder Reviewer, I want to review BRD entries in a standardized format so that I can assess requirements for the specstest Windows application efficiently
As a Project Manager, I want to track architecture baseline review status so that build planning reflects approved documentation gates

As an Information Security Analyst, I want to review runtime prerequisites against enterprise desktop security standards so that the Windows application baseline aligns with controlled Windows environments
As a Release Manager, I want to confirm prerequisite readiness before final build approval so that packaging and deployment are based on supported client conditions
As a Support Lead, I want packaging and deployment decisions documented together so that operational teams can support installation and rollout issues consistently
As a Solution Architect, I want to define the specstest desktop application as a Windows application so that the project is implemented on the correct client platform
As a Release Manager, I want to record supported Windows client prerequisites so that the specstest application can be deployed to compliant desktop environments
